title: Design System: 阿良 One Liang

display.purpose: Hero headline and contact headline only; Noto Sans TC Black, ceiling 4.75rem.

headline.purpose: Section titles: 作品卷宗, 服務委託單, 關於阿良.

title.purpose: Case names on the folder label.

title-sm.purpose: Sheet titles (附件：技能與工具) and commission row titles (1.25rem).

lede.purpose: Intro lines under display and section titles; max 34em.

body.purpose: All running CJK text; 1.0625rem at line-height 1.8.

body-prose.purpose: Multi-paragraph prose on the about sheet; line-height 1.95, measure 38em.

label.purpose: Printed form captions in the label column (承辦人, 類型, 技術, 網址); 0.8125–0.875rem, tracked 0.18–0.2em.

stamp.purpose: Ink-stamp type chips; ≥19px at 900 so stamp text counts as large text.

typed.purpose: Courier Prime for data a clerk would type: tech lists, URLs, counts, the email address. Never headings, labels or prose.

typed-index.purpose: Case numbers No.01–08 on folder tabs and the binding.

hand.purpose: LXGW WenKai TC handwritten notes with leader arrows, in pencil graphite.

hand-tag.purpose: The handwritten 開啟網站 tag on screenshots, the only pen-blue handwriting.

shadows.name: folder
shadows.purpose: Case folder bodies; the hero cover uses 0 28px 56px -30px with a 0.18 top highlight.

shadows.name: sheet
shadows.purpose: About sheets; the commission form uses 0 30px 60px -36px.

shadows.name: spine
shadows.purpose: Desktop binding spine: inner fold shade plus contact shadow.

shadows.name: print
shadows.purpose: Case screenshot prints; the ID photo uses 0 14px 22px -14px / 0.8.

shadows.name: tab
shadows.purpose: Index tabs, theme toggle, current binding slip.

shadows.name: tag
shadows.purpose: The 開啟網站 paper tag.

shadows.name: header
shadows.purpose: Sticky header once the hero folder leaves the viewport (data-scrolled).

shadows.name: clip
shadows.purpose: filter: on paperclips and the binding fastener (0.4).

shadows.name: seal-ring
shadows.purpose: Inner ring of the solid 良 brand seal.

motion.name: paper-ease
motion.purpose: Every paper movement: folders settling, prints sliding, tabs dropping, Flip reorder.

motion.name: stamp-ease
motion.purpose: Stamps pressing down with a slight overshoot.

motion.name: ui-fade
motion.purpose: Colour, background and border changes on controls.

motion.name: tab-drop
motion.purpose: Hanging index tabs and theme toggle.

motion.name: hero-entrance
motion.value: folder y48 rotate2.2 1.3s; photo y-36 rotate14 1.1s @0.25; seal scale1.9 rotate-40 0.55s back.out(2.2) @0.85
motion.purpose: First-load timeline, from() so content is visible without JS.

motion.name: case-reveal
motion.value: ScrollTrigger start 'top 78%' once; print yPercent14 ±4deg 1.1s; stamp scale1.8 0.45s @0.35; leaders 0.6s @0.55
motion.purpose: Each case folder on first scroll into view.

motion.name: filter-flip
motion.value: Flip 0.7s expo.out absolute nested; enter y40→0 0.6s; leave y-20 fade 0.3s
motion.purpose: Reordering folders when a type filter is pressed.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: gsap.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)') gate; CSS transition/animation-duration 0.01ms; smooth scroll only without reduce
motion.purpose: Everything static and visible when motion is reduced.

breakpoints.name: mobile-max
breakpoints.purpose: Hero stacks photo→headline→fields; latin brand and toggle label hidden; tabs step 9%.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Works head, commission head and tick lists go two-column.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: Case body 1.7fr/1fr alternating; pencil notes float with arrows; about two-column.

breakpoints.name: spine
breakpoints.purpose: Binding spine column (11.5rem) replaces the sticky index strip.

focus.note: Chosen by the surface the ring lands on, not the element’s own material.

textures.name: grain-kraft
textures.value: feTurbulence fractalNoise baseFrequency 0.9, 3 octaves, brown matrix alpha 0.6/-0.16, 260px tile

textures.name: grain-fiber
textures.value: feTurbulence fractalNoise baseFrequency 0.008 0.42, 2 octaves, seed 4, alpha 0.5/-0.18, 420px tile
textures.purpose: Directional fibres layered over grain-kraft on large kraft surfaces.

textures.name: grain-fiber-dark
textures.purpose: Night kraft: finer, lighter fibres so #4A3B27 reads as paper, not wood.

textures.name: grain-desk
textures.value: feTurbulence fractalNoise baseFrequency 0.7, 3 octaves, seed 11, green matrix alpha 0.5/-0.12, 300px tile

textures.name: ink
textures.value: SVG filter #ink: fractalNoise 0.8 → displacement 1.1 → speckle mask (alpha -1.1/1.45) composited in
textures.purpose: Rough edges and speckle on every stamp impression.

themes.darkOverrides: Stamps and the hero seal switch mix-blend-mode multiply → normal; desk button inverts to desk-ink fill with desk text; shadow tint becomes pure black.

components.name: Desk Button
components.description: Primary action on kraft or paper (寄信洽詢, 寄出委託單). Green, never yellow, on kraft: sun fails 1.4.11 there. Inverts to a chalk fill in dark mode.

components.name: Binding Spine
components.description: Desktop (≥75rem) sticky case index: kraft-deep spine with a metal fastener and punched holes; the current case is a paper slip sticking 1rem out. narrative.overview:
The page is a desk in a Taiwanese office. A pressboard-green desk owns the ground. Kraft case folders (卷宗) with index tabs hold the work. Cool file paper holds anything meant for reading. Vermilion rubber stamps mark status and type, ballpoint-pen blue marks only what opens something, and pencil graphite carries the handwritten notes. Every component is an object you would find on that desk. The page takes its grid language from the form printed on the folder cover: field rows, a fixed label column and heavy rules.

Density is calm and readable. CJK body text runs large and loose (1.0625rem, line-height 1.8 to 1.95), and hierarchy comes only from size contrast between Noto Sans TC Black display type and regular body type. Objects sit a little askew (−0.8° to 3°) and cast soft, green-tinted contact shadows. When they move, they move like paper: folders settle onto the desk, prints slide out of the folder mouth, stamps press down, and pencil leaders draw themselves in. Light mode is the default. Dark mode is a night version of the same desk that the visitor turns on with the toggle tab.

Confirmed rejections: the industry-default portfolio (copy on the left, avatar on the right, then a row of equal work cards); cream or warm paper (the file paper is cool on purpose, so it reads against the kraft); and yellow fills on kraft, which fail WCAG 1.4.11 boundary contrast.
keyCharacteristics: Three materials with three ink sets: desk green, kraft folder, cool file paper.
Every case uses the same printed field rows: 類型 / 技術 / 簡述 / 網址.
Stamps are ink impressions: a transparent ground, a currentColor border, roughened edges, multiply blending.
Each typeface has one job: Noto Sans TC for the voice, Courier Prime for typed data, LXGW WenKai TC for handwriting.
Paper-physics motion (expo.out), all of it gated behind prefers-reduced-motion.
Index tabs hang from the header. The binding spine marks your place in the stack.

rules.name: The Sun Is for Doing Rule
rules.body: Sun yellow appears only where the visitor acts on the green desk: primary buttons, the focus ring and the 聯絡 tab. It never fills anything on kraft or paper, where it measures 1.22:1 against kraft.

rules.name: The Pen Opens Things Rule
rules.body: Ballpoint blue means "this opens something": links and the 開啟網站 tags. Headings, notes and decoration never use it.

rules.name: The Two Reds Rule
rules.body: Stamp ink depends on what it lands on: #C2301D on paper and #7A180E on kraft. The paper red on kraft measures 2.54:1, so never cross them.

rules.name: The Focus Follows the Ground Rule
rules.body: --focus is set by the surface the 3px ring lands on: sun on the desk, pen blue on kraft or paper.

rules.name: The Typed Is Data Rule
rules.body: Courier Prime sets only data a clerk would type into the form: case numbers, URLs, tech lists, index numbers, counts, the email address. It is not a costume for "technical", so never use it for headings, labels or prose.

rules.name: The Size Is Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Rank comes from size contrast between 900 and 400, never from color or a third weight. The same Noto Sans TC Black carries every level of title.

rules.name: The Pencil Rule
rules.body: Handwritten notes are pencil graphite (#3D3120 on kraft). The only pen-blue handwriting is the 開啟網站 tag, because it opens something.

rules.name: The CJK Leading Rule
rules.body: Running CJK text stays at 1.0625rem with line-height 1.8 to 1.95. Tighter leading (1.12–1.3) is only for 900-weight titles of 1.375rem and up, and for one-line UI labels.

rules.name: The Thickness Rule
rules.body: Shadow length follows how thick the object is: folders and sheets > flap and spine > print > tab and tag. A new object takes the shadow of the real object it imitates.

rules.name: The Contact Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every shadow uses negative spread and the desk-green tint. A shadow that rings an element, or a flat black offset shadow, does not belong on this desk.

dos: Do put every new surface on one of the three materials (desk #1E5A45, kraft #CFA86C, file paper #F7F6F1), and take its text color from that material's ink tokens.
Do use the desk-green button for primary actions on kraft or paper, and the sun button only on the green desk.
Do set --focus by the surface the ring lands on: sun on the desk, pen blue on kraft or paper (3px solid, 3px offset).
Do stamp, don't fill: a transparent ground, a 2px currentColor border, filter: url(#ink), multiply in light mode, rotated −2° to −14°.
Do keep stamp text on kraft at 1.2rem/900 or larger in #7A180E, and use #C2301D only on paper.
Do set Courier Prime only on typed data: case numbers, URLs, tech lists, counts, the email address.
Do write annotations in LXGW WenKai TC 700 in pencil graphite (#3D3120).
Do keep running text at 1.0625rem with line-height 1.8 (1.95 for prose), with measures of 34–40em.
Do tint every shadow with --shadow-rgb and give it negative spread, sized to the object's thickness.
Do keep content visible in the HTML and animate with GSAP .from() (expo.out) inside gsap.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)').
Do default to light and switch to dark only through the toggle, stored in localStorage['liang-theme'] and applied before first paint.
donts: Don't fill controls with sun yellow on kraft or paper (1.22:1 against kraft fails WCAG 1.4.11).
Don't use pen blue for headings, notes, rules or decoration. It means "this opens something".
Don't warm the file paper toward cream. Its coolness is what separates it from kraft.
Don't put the paper red #C2301D on kraft (2.54:1).
Don't use Courier Prime as a "technical" costume for headings, labels or prose.
Don't follow prefers-color-scheme. Dark mode is the visitor's choice only.
Don't give a status or type stamp a solid fill. The 良 brand mark is the only solid seal.
Don't build hierarchy with color or extra weights. Size contrast between 900 and 400 carries it.
Don't use hard offset shadows, or untinted black shadows in light mode.
Don't lay the work out as a row of equal cards beside a copy-left, avatar-right hero.
knownGaps: The desktop binding spine is a separate sticky column about 40px from the folders, not attached to their edge.
The punched holes repeat every 1.7rem down the spine and read like list bullets.
The mobile index strip gives no cue that No.06–08 are off-screen to the right.
The hero's No.01 peek sliver fades into the desk through a mask gradient instead of ending on a hard paper edge, and the real No.01 tab appears just below it, so No.01 shows twice.
drift: Pen blue also colors the commission form's handwritten status line, which is outside its reservation for links and 開啟網站.
Courier Prime is applied to two pieces that are not data: the 委託案件 flap label (it actually renders in the Noto Sans TC fallback) and the hero seal's ring legend.
Sun yellow also appears in ::selection on every surface, and in the contact email's underline and hover color.
The favicon is an outlined (朱文) seal in #9C2416, a red that is not a token, while the header uses the solid 白文 seal in stamp red.
Print White and the screenshot placeholders (#ECE8DD, #E9E6DC) are literal values, not custom properties.
The cover-form rows (承辦人 / 服務 / 經手 / 聯絡) are set in Noto Sans TC. The brief specified typed rows of 承辦人 / 服務 / 狀態.
